New V&V file ph_flash_region4_edge_and_region5.rs: 4 tests (round-trip at exact sat_pressure_4(273.15) recovers T=273.15K/x=0.30/mixture v,s vs 0degC IST row <1e-4; neighbourhood; Region5 should_panic; Region4 (T,p) should_panic). cargo test -p tampines-steam-tables --release --lib: 915 passed 0 failed 14 ignored. Doc in docs/notes.md 2026-07-15 section. Left in place: (T,p) router exact-float-equality Region4 detection FMA-fragility (pre-existing, (p,h) path no longer depends on it).

title: ph_flash: fix Region 4 (T,p) todo!() trap at p_sat(273.15K) edge + explicit Region 5 unsupported

description: gen_api_docs.py runs cargo doc without features, so any feature-gated public module is absent from the generated docs/api.md mirror. Concretely outram-blender's docs/api.md omits sim (mc-export) and foam_mesh (foam-mesh) entirely -- the crate's two solver bridges, its most consequential public surface. Will affect every crate with opt-in bridges. Add a per-crate feature list (e.g. --all-features or a mapping in the script), and consider whether --all-features is safe for Android-hostile optional deps. Same script also auto-installs rustdoc-md without asking -- see the separate bead on that.
title: scripts/gen_api_docs.py: feature-gated public modules silently missing from api.md

description:
Maintainer request, 2026-08-14. HtgrSnapshot::default().feedwater_manual is currently false (AUTO) -- see app/mod.rs test the_gui_defaults_are_the_plant_command_defaults, which pins the opening frame to FeedwaterCommand::Auto. Change the default so the simulator opens with the feedwater station in MANUAL.

Note op-tj10 (the feedforward-controller limit-cycle bug) is open against the AUTO path -- defaulting to MANUAL sidesteps that oscillation on launch, which may be part of the motivation; do not treat this bead as a substitute fix for op-tj10.

Touch points: HtgrSnapshot::default() (app/state.rs) for the opening value, and the pinned test the_gui_defaults_are_the_plant_command_defaults (app/mod.rs) will need its AUTO assertions swapped to MANUAL -- that test exists specifically to pin the opening frame's command set, so update it deliberately rather than deleting it.
title: htgr_sim_v1: feedwater station should default to MANUAL, not AUTO
